in_marathi.name: Tanvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dazzling, Radiant Goddess
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tanvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tanu (dazzling, radiant) + Vika (goddess). Derived from the Sanskrit language, Tanvika is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu tradition. This name is associated with the goddesses of love, beauty, and fertility. It symbolizes the inner light and divine grace that every girl embodies.
